headline: Gutter Rekindles as Flag Fighting Spreads to Farranac Coast
war_summary: Gutter, near silent at our last writing, has roared back to life: eleven flag changes inside two hours and seventy-three on the day, with Kuoppa and The Parras the busiest posts and its seven strongpoints now split five Wardens, one Colonial, one in no-man's-land. The Nevish Line still bleeds heavily — better than six hundred Colonial and three hundred eighty Warden losses in two hours — though its final hour shows cooling and its flag work has slowed from the last edition's pace. Weathered Expanse grinds on regardless: forty-four flag events on the day and two of its nine bases still rubble, the rest standing five Wardens to two Colonials. Linn Mercy saw flags turn at Outwich Ranch while casualty rates there climb; Palantine Berm's flag trade has resumed after its pause, two changes in the past two hours. Fresh movement has opened at Farranac Coast, where Wardens carried a post at Transient Valley as the hour closed. Callahans Passage, motionless on flags, keeps a grim ledger of some eighteen thousand casualties on the day, while Olavis Wake, long quiet, suddenly counts nearly three hundred fresh losses. This is the war's 649th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
